description: Defines the ProxyBypassRules class for managing URL bypass rules for proxies, including rule parsing, matching, and serialization.

classes.name: ProxyBypassRules
classes.description: Manages a list of URL bypass rules for proxy configuration, including parsing, matching, and serialization.

methods.name: rules
methods.description: Returns the current list of rules.

methods.name: ReplaceRule
methods.description: Replaces a rule at a specified index.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if a URL should bypass the proxy based on rules.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two ProxyBypassRules instances.

methods.name: PrependRuleToBypassSimpleHostnames
methods.description: Adds a rule to bypass simple hostnames.

methods.name: AddRuleFromString
methods.description: Adds a rule from a string.

methods.name: AddRulesToSubtractImplicit
methods.description: Adds rules to cancel out implicit bypass rules.

methods.name: GetRulesToSubtractImplicit
methods.description: Returns rules that cancel out implicit bypass rules.

methods.name: MatchesImplicitRules
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches implicit bypass rules.
